requirements.statement: Every question /refine-prd (Phase 0 and Phase 2) and /refine-trd (Phase 0 and Phase 2) puts to the owner in interactive mode marks one option "(Recommended)", lists it first and gives a one-line reason, or says plainly why there is no recommendation. Must pass.
In a multi-select batch of findings the rule applies to each finding on its own, and each finding is explained in plain words, never by its id alone. Must pass.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O2 (source: issue #59, Change bullets 2 and 3)

requirements.statement: /refine-verification and /refine-design state the same rule in the same terms, so all four refine commands ask the same way.
The .claude/commands/ copies of all four commands are byte-identical to packages/core/commands/, and a test pins the rule's wording in each.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives, O4 (source: issue #59, Done when)

requirements.statement: Each of the four files contains the heading "### Putting a question to the owner" and the phrases: marks one option "(Recommended)", "lists it first", "one-line reason", "say so plainly in the question text", "the author's recorded assumption", "what the non-interactive mode would do", "at most four findings in one question", "the rule applies to each finding", and "never by its id alone". These tests fail on today's files.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criterion (1)

requirements.statement: The subsection, from its heading to the next heading, with whitespace collapsed, is identical in all four files.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criterion (2)

requirements.statement: Each asking site, tested in its own slice, contains "Putting a question to the owner": refine-prd and refine-trd Phase 0 and Phase 2 (each sliced by phase heading); refine-verification ### Interactive and the must-pass owner-ruling bullet; refine-design's conditional-on-mode paragraph alone. Removing any one pointer fails the test.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criterion (3)

requirements.statement: .claude/commands/<name>.md is byte-identical to packages/core/commands/<name>.md for all four commands. Guards against regressions only; passes today.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criterion (4)

requirements.statement: The existing refine-design-prose.test.js, refine-verification-must-pass.test.js and verify-command-surface.test.js still pass, and the full Jest (npx jest) and BATS batteries pass.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, FIX-001 acceptance criterion (5)

tasks.description: Add the "### Putting a question to the owner" subsection (verbatim text from the TRD's Decision section) to the ## Modes section of refine-prd.md, refine-trd.md, refine-verification.md and refine-design.md in packages/core/commands/. Add the one-sentence pointer at every interactive asking site (refine-prd and refine-trd Phase 0 and Phase 2 Interactive; refine-verification ### Interactive and the must-pass owner-ruling line under Derive; refine-design Modes paragraph, replacing the "Every question names one option" sentence to point at the subsection). Mirror all four files to .claude/commands/ with cp, and add packages/core/commands/refine-recommend-prose.test.js pinning the rule.
